prompt: You asked for "short" answers and get anything from one line to three paragraphs.
The model keeps using ellipses in voice replies even though you told it not to. The text is read aloud by a speech engine.
tells: read aloud by a speech engine
why: Give the reason: the speech engine can't pronounce ellipses. Models generalize better from the why.
trap: Repeating the rule louder isn't the fix.

prompt: "Don't use markdown" still produces some bullets. You want flowing prose paragraphs.
why: Say what to do ("write in flowing paragraphs") rather than only what not to do.
trap: Positive instructions steer better than bans.

prompt: An agent asked to "improve the README" stops after fixing one typo.
why: Define what a finished result includes: sections, audience, examples.
trap: The task had no definition of done.
